verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs say you install the GitHub App to grant the agent access to your repositories, with "No complex setup required". This matches the story's core. Related docs show the agent then manages repositories, and the CLI and setup-commands endpoint help configure them. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the install flow and repository/permission scoping, support for non-GitHub hosts, and any independent or hands-on confirmation that setup is actually one-click.
